truth_split.current_global_control: persistent owner shell v2 at the Prometeo root; exact current ownership must be resolved from current pointers/bytes, not compatibility names
truth_split.plan_page: plan_de_accion_bicolor_v1.html is a separate concrete surface artifact and must not be collapsed into global root ownership
truth_split.historical_migration_baseline: Universal Control V5 remains useful historical/migration evidence but is superseded as root owner
truth_split.authority_gap: control-plan / plan_de_accion_bicolor_v1.html is not presently authoritative merely because workers discuss or analyze it; registry/catalog authority is separate

protected_invariants.rule: Plan page ownership, global root ownership, candidate work and historical V5 lineage remain separate typed facts.
protected_invariants.failure_signal: A worker/integrator promotes the Plan page to root owner, or treats historical V5 served wording/PAGE_ID as current root authority without pointer/blob evidence.

protected_invariants.rule: A worker return may add scoped candidate evidence but may not set Current, Human Accepted or Served, nor mutate catalog/current graph merely to make its own result authoritative.
protected_invariants.failure_signal: Any surface worker changes Current/Served/Human Accepted authority or authoritative registry pointers outside a separately authorized integration/promotion action.

protected_invariants.rule: Swarm-editable surface work must default to isolated campaign/change-thread candidates; served root/product bytes are preserved until an authorized promotion boundary.
protected_invariants.failure_signal: Routine surface work directly rewrites root owner bytes or live plan-page bytes.

protected_invariants.rule: Human correction/work launched from Control Plan must preserve enough route/surface identity to return visibly to the same surface rather than ejecting to a generic control room.
protected_invariants.failure_signal: A one-message correction loses originating surface identity or requires human result transport/routing.

protected_invariants.rule: Distinct workers must hold exclusive claim/recovery ownership before substantive scoped mutation; collision loss must select other work rather than duplicate execution.
protected_invariants.failure_signal: Two live workers make overlapping substantive writes without an exclusive claim/recovery lineage.

protected_invariants.rule: RETURN evidence remains immutable candidate evidence; integration/disposition is a separate act with explicit consumed/conflicted/deferred scope decisions.
protected_invariants.failure_signal: Newest return silently wins, older evidence is overwritten, or RETURN presence alone changes product authority.

protected_invariants.rule: If the original stale worker later returns after recovery, both returns remain durable and are reconciled; recovery must not erase or falsely mark the original failed solely from silence.
protected_invariants.failure_signal: Late original evidence is deleted, overwritten, ignored by path convention, or recovery is treated as proof the original result is invalid.

protected_invariants.rule: Runtime projections may lag rapidly moving main; mutation decisions must refetch exact target SHA/head immediately before CAS/create operations.
protected_invariants.failure_signal: A worker writes from an old compiled main_head/epoch without target refetch, or uses projection freshness as authority for bytes it did not reopen.

protected_invariants.rule: /wc remains a canary; surface success cannot promote production /w or claim swarm graduation.
protected_invariants.failure_signal: A local Control Plan integration or worker return marks /w production-ready absent stress verifier, fresh critic and production-readiness evidence.

protected_invariants.rule: Swarm-editability must reduce, not increase, manual human routing, result transport, scheduling or memory burden.
protected_invariants.failure_signal: Control Plan requires the human to number workers, relay returns, choose merge order or remember stale attempts.

adversarial_regressions.attack: Classify owner shell by PAGE_ID/name token and resurrect Universal Control V5 as current because owner shell v2 retains a v5 compatibility identifier.

falsification_test.procedure: Resolve root owner from current root pointer + exact referenced implementation/blob; separately inspect PAGE_ID. Assert ownership classification is unchanged when compatibility PAGE_ID contains 'v5'.
falsification_test.pass: Root owner remains owner shell v2; V5 remains historical/migration lineage.
falsification_test.fail: Classifier promotes V5 from string identity alone.

adversarial_regressions.attack: Treat the conceptual 'Plan de acción / Universal Control' surface_id as one concrete owner and overwrite root control with plan-page work.

falsification_test.procedure: Build a fixture containing separate plan-page and global-control authorities under the same surface_id. Run local integration classification.
falsification_test.pass: Two components remain separately typed/dispositioned and neither is silently promoted.
falsification_test.fail: Integrator emits a single owner or applies plan-page candidate bytes to root ownership.

adversarial_regressions.attack: Resolve the current registry gap by having the same worker register its own candidate as Current/Served.

falsification_test.procedure: Feed an unregistered surface candidate to a surface worker with no promotion authority.
falsification_test.pass: Worker emits evidence/proposal only; authoritative registry state is unchanged.
falsification_test.fail: Candidate is inserted as Current/Served solely to remove ambiguity.

adversarial_regressions.attack: Concurrent swarm returns are applied by recency/order rather than explicit evidence-scoped disposition.

falsification_test.procedure: Replay the same conflicting returns in opposite arrival orders against a pinned integration cutoff.
falsification_test.pass: Disposition is deterministic from evidence/authority/scope and order-independent; conflict remains explicit when unresolved.
falsification_test.fail: Outcome changes because the last return wins.

adversarial_regressions.attack: Recovered worker finishes, then stale original returns and overwrites/replaces the recovery result or vice versa.

falsification_test.procedure: Simulate recovery RETURN followed by late original RETURN for the same opportunity.
falsification_test.pass: Both immutable returns remain addressable and integration records a disposition for each; no evidence deletion.
falsification_test.fail: One path overwrites or silently supersedes the other.

adversarial_regressions.attack: Use gh-pages manifest epoch/main_head as if it were a transactional lock while live main advances during a broad worker wave.

falsification_test.procedure: Pin a runtime projection, advance main, then attempt a mutation using the stale projection without target refetch.
falsification_test.pass: Protocol refuses/forces exact refetch + CAS/create-if-absent before write.
falsification_test.fail: Stale projection is accepted as sufficient byte authority.

adversarial_regressions.attack: One-message human correction launches work but result lands only in global coordination files and the page cannot recover its originating route/state.

falsification_test.procedure: Create a correction from Control Plan, run worker/integration path, then reopen the surface from durable receipt alone.
falsification_test.pass: Origin surface + route/change-thread identity are sufficient to return to the same visible work context.
falsification_test.fail: Human must search/relay result or navigate from scratch.

adversarial_regressions.attack: A successful local surface integration is mistaken for universal-worker production readiness.

falsification_test.procedure: Mark all Control Plan lens dependencies returned while stress verifier/fresh critic/production-readiness gates remain incomplete.
falsification_test.pass: Local integration may become READY, but /w stays unpromoted.
falsification_test.fail: Any local completion changes production /w authority.

dedup.reason: The needed execution homes already exist: O-SURFACE-CONTROL_PLAN-LOCAL-INTEGRATE-V1 for disposition/gates, O-SWARM-LOCAL-STEWARD-BUILD-V1 for reconciliation semantics, O-SWARM-PAGE-THREAD-BRIDGE-V1 for same-surface correction return, O-SWARM-SURFACE-REGISTRY-BUILD-V1 for registry mechanics, O-SWARM-50-WORKER-STRESS-VERIFY-V1 for broad race/recovery evidence, and O-SWARM-PRODUCTION-W-READINESS-V1 for promotion gating. Creating parallel fixes here would duplicate active lanes.
dedup.integration_instruction: Consume this artifact as mandatory negative-test/invariant input when Control Plan local integration becomes dependency-ready.

truth_ceiling: This artifact defines evidence-backed regression risks and falsification contracts. It does not prove those tests are already implemented/executed by the future local integrator, does not promote the surface, and does not establish production /w readiness.
